I sent Pree the list in our DM. I read the whole #central-team channel (I checked first that Pree is a member), and only three Marrow Agrisupply sites are named there:

1. **Eastbank:** from Hollis's message on Jun 9, 2026. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The import labels the doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs to be fixed before anyone reimports, or there will be duplicates.
2. **Pine Crossing:** from Pree's own message on Jun 9, 2026. Their appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it.
3. **Wichita store:** from Pree's message on Jul 2, 2025. She mentioned a check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher on the Marrow Agrisupply office-hours link. The channel never says outright that this store belongs to Marrow Agrisupply, so I asked her to confirm it.

I also told her two things that might mean more sites exist. The Jun 9 thread says three rows on the customer's rollout tracker just read "waiting," but those stores aren't named in the channel. And the store-by-store list she was going to send Hollis was never posted there.

I left out Salina North. It turned up in the GBrain notes, but it isn't from #central-team and it belongs to a different account, Marrow Fieldworks.
